name: PF1e Spells
note: M15: the spells pf1e-core ships. Every entry carries the published stat-block lines (school, descriptors, components, casting time, range, target or area, duration, saving throw, spell resistance) and an `automation` declaration. `automated` entries ship a `system.massBattle` block that parsePackSpellOrder validates and the mass-battle resolver executes; `descriptive` entries ship `automationNote` naming what the resolver cannot do and, where the intent is worth keeping, a `system.massBattleIntent` block that NO code reads. Entries are content: nothing in src/** imports this file — it reaches the app only as a file inside an imported package record in IndexedDB. tests/packages/pf1eContentPacks.test.ts pins the automated set against the module's registry, entry for entry.

components.material: a ball of bat guano and sulfur

massBattle.notes: Transcribed from the Core Rulebook's Fireball entry (R02, D-151): 20-ft.-radius spread, long range, 1d6 points of fire damage per caster level (maximum 10d6), Reflex half for half damage, spell resistance yes. radiusFeet, rangeCategory, saveType, halfOnSave and the dice are the fields the mass-battle order consumes; the sim derives the save DC as 10 + spell level + casting ability modifier (spellSaveDc) and never reads a hard-coded DC. Evasion applies because the spell is Reflex half.

Transcribed from PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 251 (R02): 15-ft cone-shaped burst, 1d4 fire per caster level (maximum 5d4), Reflex half, SR yes. A cone starts at the caster and widens out; it does not designate a remote point of origin, so there is no rangeCategory. Evasion applies because the spell is Reflex half.

components.material: a small silver or crystal cup

massBattle.notes: Transcribed from the Core Rulebook's Cone of Cold entry: a 60-ft. cone, 1d6 points of cold damage per caster level (maximum 10d6), Reflex half, spell resistance yes. The cone's length and the spell's range are the same published number, and a cone shoots away from the caster, so there is no rangeCategory (CRB pp.213-214). The freezing of water and the fragility of cold-immunity-less objects are not modelled at this scale.

massBattle.notes: Transcribed from the Core Rulebook's Lightning Bolt entry: a line 100 ft. long + 10 ft. per caster level and 5 ft. wide, 1d6 points of electricity damage per caster level (maximum 10d6), Reflex half, spell resistance yes. radiusFeet is the line's BASE length and lengthFeetPerCasterLevel the per-level extension, because '+X ft./level' ranges count the 1st level (unlike close/medium/long, whose arithmetic spellRangeFeet owns). The bolt's spread into conductive liquid and its 10%-per-5-ft. fire chance are not modelled.
